W4396622158.title: The Hiking Optimization Algorithm: A novel human-based metaheuristic approach
W4396622158.abstract: In this paper, a novel metaheuristic called ‘The Hiking Optimization Algorithm’ (HOA) is proposed. HOA’s mathematical model is premised on Tobler’s Hiking Function (THF), which determines the walking velocity of hikers (i.e. agents) by considering the elevation of the terrain and the distance covered.
